items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: he first played with a fellow, he called him Dr. something, he used to play all the little forward and things around there. I can't think of his name.

ctx.x: Well, I guess you weren't any relation to the Halls that played clarinet like Edmund Hall and his brother Clarence. No, no, no, no relation at all. No relation? There's another fellow, Rene Hall, from there. No, no, no, no. No relation to him. No, anything to do with it.

Thought he'd clear that up, you know, because sometimes they'd make a mistake. Sure, no, a lot of people thought Edmund Hall and I were brothers. Yeah. No relation at all. First time I met him out here. Yeah. So there was no relation at all there, just a different Hall altogether. But when he went up the first time he didn't exactly go to play music, because see when he first went there, he first played with a fellow, he called him Dr. something, he used to play all the little forward and things around there. I…
Another thing, I've seen somebody told me that your brother might have gone up with Tigg Chambers. Do you remember Tigg Chambers ever?
